name: National Ginger Producers, Processors and Marketers Association (NGPPMAN)
why_contact: Publishes farm-gate + market price table by hub; sets quality params (moisture max 12%; oleoresin 1.5-3.0%; impurities max 2%)

name: AFEX Commodities Exchange
why_contact: Warehouse receipts + quality assurance; their production estimates are the ones the press quotes; lowest counterparty risk route

name: National Ginger Association of Nigeria (NGAN)
why_contact: Runs the 3-year seedbank project that is deliberately keeping supply tight; knows who can actually sell this season

name: Nigerian Export Promotion Council (NEPC)
why_contact: Registration is mandatory to export legally; nepc.gov.ng/importer/nigeria-product/ginger/ lists vetted exporters

name: National Agricultural Development Fund (NADF)
why_contact: Runs GRATE (N1.6bn / 15000 farmers) and GVCRSP with NRCRI Umudike; knows which farms and factories are being rebuilt

name: Ginger Growers, Processors and Marketers Association
why_contact: Separate body from NGAN; quoted on the 2026 seed price crisis

name: Jeffy Farms
why_contact: Named price source in BusinessDay (N13m-17m/MT export-grade dry split); no broker layer

name: Falke Industries Limited
why_contact: Named industry voice on seed supply; direct producer contact
